title: Path of Exile 2
notes: D3D12: D3DMetal. Tested with MSync and ESync off (GameToMac).

knownIssues.symptom: Freezes after connecting to the login server
knownIssues.cause: Wine misreads NtQueryDirectoryObject's BOOLEAN argument, so the drive scan loops forever
knownIssues.fix: A GamePort engine patch (planned: 0101). Until then it may not work.
